deterministic_executions.proves: The Aliche pack cases are internally executable: the figures and hard-gate classifications stated in each case reproduce exactly from the committed case inputs under the pack framework affordability procedure.
Section 32.2 arithmetic (132/22, 168/22, 145/22; abstention variant 150 over 19, coverage 19/22) and the WAIT outcome reproduce through the CWE-026 analyzeDecision service.

All nine committed pack corpora contain zero quotation units and reject probe tuples fail-closed; wrong-speaker, locator, rights, revocation, other-seat, and generated-rounds attributions behave per Section 8.4 on the CWE-012 fixture corpora, with a verified positive control.
One seat, three lenses, one vote holds structurally: three-lens one-vote cards pass; vote inflation, foreign lenses, and unknown lenses are diagnosed.
Instruction text embedded in pack evidence is a validation error (SOURCE_INJECTION_CONTENT).
Audit hashes are a deterministic function of pack content, validator version, and the host-supplied audited_at input.
Weights sum to one; thresholds, hard-failure override, baseline comparison, per-mode separation, and differentiation thresholds behave mechanically on hand-computed synthetic grade sets.
